verdict.rationale:
Docs show a dedicated scenario-modeling feature (model future rounds, IRR/cash-on-cash, export scenarios to review with team) plus automated equity financing that generates term sheets and financing documents, and separate convertible-note creation — covering much of the priced-round/dilution/pro-forma workflow. However, there is no explicit mention of option-pool top-up modeling, SAFE conversion mechanics within the modeling tool, or a documented way to share scenarios specifically with counsel/investors (only 'export scenarios to review with your team').
missing for 10: explicit SAFE conversion modeling, option pool top-up feature, counsel/investor-specific sharing/collaboration workflow
